title: Random-example cost of the junta learner
statement: For every integer $k \ge 0$ and every accuracy parameter $\varepsilon \in [0,1/2]$, the number of random labeled examples used by the low-degree junta learning algorithm on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube is $O\bigl((n+1)^{\lfloor 3k/4\rfloor+3}\bigr)$ as $n \to \infty$.
